title: Measured SAT and sparse witness recovery through fixed-size 2-CNF variable deletion
claims: ExactTwoSATBackdoor checks P membership for canonical fixed-size 2-CNF variable-deletion domain recognition and for its satisfiable subset.
MeasuredTwoSATBackdoor can combine that domain check with satisfiability of a sublist of the original clauses, using three candidate variables and both signs per level.
TwoSATBackdoorSearch constructs a satisfying assignment as a sparse list of true variable codes with encoded length at most that of the original formula.

experiments.purpose: Bind the archived Lean modules and exact statements to the recorded local reference replay. The isolated experiment reports zero Lean invocations and can be complemented by replay with the pinned reference.
